name: rm-operations-app
description: RM Operations App — the internal operations platform for RM Cardz.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.web: npm run build && npm run build:server && node out/server/index.cjs
scripts.test:labels: node tests/build.mjs tests/shippingLabels.test.ts out/tests/shippingLabels.cjs && node out/tests/shippingLabels.cjs
